resources.string: Turns the Smart Dial on your CMF Buds Pro 2 case into a scroll wheel. It watches media volume changes made by the dial, puts the volume back, and performs the action you chose (scroll, swipe to next reel, zoom, …) as a touch gesture. It reads which app is in front to apply per-app rules and checks your phone\'s volume keys so they are not mistaken for the dial. No data leaves your phone.
Dial Pilot needs its accessibility service to scroll other apps. If Android says the setting is restricted, open App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Not capturing: no headset matching \"%1$s\" is connected
Not capturing: this app is set to Volume
Turn the dial now. If \"changes seen\" doesn\'t go up, your buds aren\'t telling the phone about the turn.
Scrolls the app you switch to once, 3 seconds after you tap.
No rules yet. Every app uses the default action.
Turn the other way to scroll forward.
While the dial is captured, the phone\'s volume keys act like the dial.
Otherwise the volume keys and speaker volume are captured too.
Tap a connected device to use its name:

1. In the Nothing X app, open your CMF Buds Pro 2 → Smart Dial and set rotation to "Volume".
2. Turn on the Dial Pilot accessibility service above.
3. Open any app and turn the dial. Dial Pilot reads each volume step, sets the volume back, and runs the action you picked.

The dial is left as a volume control while the screen is off or locked, while your buds are disconnected, in apps set to "Volume", and when the master switch or Quick Settings tile is off.

Android may briefly show the volume slider on each turn. Bluetooth volume steps don't always line up with phone steps, so some turns can need two clicks.
Smooth scrolling for web pages, PDFs, feeds and chats.
Sideways scrolling for carousels, timelines and horizontal PDFs.
One click jumps one item: Reels, Shorts, TikTok, stories, photos.
Asks the app to scroll exactly one page. Works in Chrome and most lists, not in apps that draw their own content.
Pinch in and out at the centre of the screen. For PDFs, maps and photos.
Skips tracks in whatever is playing.
